walkthrough:
Step 1: Calculate the summary sums for all n = 30 runners:
- Falcons ($n_1 = 15$):
  * $\sum x_1 = 772$
  * $\sum x_1^2 = 41532$
- Kites ($n_2 = 15$):
  * $\sum x_2 = 784$
  * $\sum x_2^2 = 42218$
Combined totals ($n = 30$):
$$\sum x = 772 + 784 = 1556$$
$$\sum x^2 = 41532 + 42218 = 83750$$

Step 2: Calculate the mean:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum x}{n} = \frac{1556}{30} = 51.866... \approx 51.9\text{ minutes}$$

Step 3: Calculate the standard deviation:
$$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{\sum x^2}{n} - \bar{x}^2}$$
$$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{83750}{30} - (51.866...)^2} = \sqrt{2791.6667 - 2690.1511} = \sqrt{101.5156} = 10.075... \approx 10.1\text{ minutes}$$
(To 3 significant figures).
